state:
**Goal `looper-ready`, Stages 2 and 3 are done on disk; Stage 4 is next.** `bun nv suite` (`tools/nv/cmd/suite.ts`) judges one `nvs-suite` check through `PlanSweep` and the shared `suiteVerdict` (`tools/nv/accept/runner.ts`). `bun nv legs` (`tools/nv/cmd/legs.ts`) builds its options with `legsOptions` (`tools/nv/accept/legs.ts`), the builder `sweepOver` also calls. `bun nv services --up` (`tools/nv/cmd/services.ts`) owns `preflight` and `bringUp`, and `cmd/loop.ts` imports them from there. A command finds its goal through `namedPlan` in `tools/nv/lib/chain.ts`: `--goal`, else `LOOPER_GOAL`, else the current goal. `tools/nv/test/driver-boundary.test.ts` holds the Stage 2 and 3 titles, and they pass. Stages 4 to 6 add their own titles to the same file.

The user's calls and the goal writer's calls are the goal file's § *Standing decisions*, and no session re-decides one. The cutover's runbook is `docs/agent/looper-cutover.md`, and the cutover is not this goal's work. `bun test -t <regex>` that matches no test exits 0, so every check here asks for the exact `Ran N tests across 1 file` line.

items.text: **`bun nv benches [--owed]`**: `benchTurn` (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:701`) moves to `cmd/benches.ts`. `nv loop --benches` (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:1342`) and its usage lines go. The guard's heavy-run rule moves to `benches` (`tools/nv/cmd/guard.ts:546`). Specified by the goal's Stage 4 section.

**`bun nv side --prepare <slug>`**: `prepare` and `seedStore` (`tools/nv/driver/side.ts:61`, `tools/nv/driver/side.ts:100`) move to `cmd/side.ts`, and `launchSide` calls them there. Specified by the goal's Stage 4 section.

**`bun nv allow --learn <events.jsonl>`**: `AllowWatch`, `record`, `owed`, `nvCommands` and `settle` (`tools/nv/driver/allow.ts:164`, `tools/nv/driver/allow.ts:215`, `tools/nv/driver/allow.ts:287`) move to `cmd/allow.ts`. Specified by the goal's Stage 4 section.

**`bun nv sweep [--done]`**: the after-session sequence in `serve()`, from the `sweep: "done"` skip (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:1119`) through `fullRunTurn` (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:680`), `setFloorSince` (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:1178`) and `sweepDisk` (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts:1184`), becomes one function in `cmd/sweep.ts` that `serve()` calls. It writes `.loop/last-sweep.md` and always exits 0. This is the largest slice, so it may fill a session on its own.
